NOW.label: WHAT WE MUST DO — the fermentation plan

tiktok.how_to_eat: TikTok has no public API. Options: (1) web scraping (risky, ToS violation), (2) TikTok Research API (requires academic application), (3) third-party aggregators (tokapi, tikwm). Recommend: tokapi.io free tier or RSS bridges.
tiktok.what_we_get: Trending sounds, hashtags, creator profiles, video metadata. NOT the video content — just the SIGNAL.

youtube.how_to_eat: YouTube Data API v3 (free, 10,000 quota units/day). Can fetch: trending videos, search results, channel stats, video metadata, captions. RSS feeds exist for every channel.
youtube.what_we_get: Trending page (50 videos), search for 'fermentation', 'membrane', 'game science', 'sourdough'. Video titles, descriptions, view counts, tags.

facebook_meta.how_to_eat: CrowdTangle API (deprecated 2024). Meta Content Library API (academic only). Practically WALLED. Use Facebook RSS bridges or public page feeds.
facebook_meta.what_we_get: Very little directly. Facebook is the most walled garden. Accept this and eat around it.

twitter_x.how_to_eat: X API free tier: 1,500 tweets/month read. Nitter instances (dying). RSS bridges. Very limited.
twitter_x.what_we_get: Trending topics. Keyword search. But heavily rate-limited.

reddit.problem: ALL 11 feeds returned 403. Reddit killed unauthenticated JSON endpoints in 2023.
reddit.fix: Need Reddit API OAuth app registration (free, 60 requests/minute). OR use old.reddit.com RSS feeds which still work: https://old.reddit.com/r/fermentation/.rss
